positive_snippets:
I was on a business trip in April 2025 and stayed here for five days. The best thing about this hotel is its location, situated on the main road of Kalindi Kunj, which connects Noida.
My Office is in Noida, and it's very convenient for me to travel from the hotel to the office. You can get a cab 24/7, it's a busy road and you always find it alive even at night. Another interesting fact about this location is that it is surrounded by a market of factory outlets of many popular brands. I enjoyed shopping too. I enjoyed my stay there as the rooms are very comfortable and the service was good. Staff were very helpful too.
I recommend this hotel for solo travelers or families on vacation, and if you are on a business trip to Noida, it is a better option than many hotels in the area.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The staff were extremely polite, welcoming, and always ready to help. The rooms were spotless, spacious, and very comfortable. I especially appreciated the attention to detail in cleanliness and amenities. The food was delicious with a wide variety of options, and the service in the restaurant was excellent. The location is also very convenient, making it easy to explore the city. Overall, a perfect combination of comfort, hospitality, and value for money. Highly recommended!"
